real_defects.issue: --state <ST> applied its preset discount only to tax lines labelled exactly '<ST> state'; a book labelled 'MI' or 'Michigan' took no discount while the state note said the discount 'is applied' (all 20 preset states, CLI and page). Reproduced on the CLI: $300 tax, payable $294 with 'MI state', $300 with 'MI', same note. Fix: presetDiscountWarning replaces the note when the preset matches no row.

run_suite's subprocess.run timeout killed only `node --test`; its per-file children running a looping mutant kept spinning 10+ minutes into later mutants (seen twice this run, killed by hand), which can time later mutants out as 'caught'. Fix with failing-first test in control-plane PR #15945 (own process group, killpg); waits for owner approval.
